fieldValues.title: Where should an essay's publication boundary live?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Raised by the muSrs essay prototype (Research: SRS carriers, part 3); the owner: "An essay is supposed to be structured with a boundary container that can be exported". No option chosen.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. A separate publication container whose children are the essay and references containers (the prototype).
- B. The essay container itself declares its references container as a child, so every essay exports whole; the editor must keep the edge.
- C. An essay blueprint creates the essay, references and boundary containers together, with the publication composition.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Whether the essay editor would preserve childContainerIds on the essay container; whether other essays need different boundaries (drafts, comments); whether the references container can be kept complete (it had drifted).
fieldValues.next_action: Ask the essay editor's owners about option B; add a check that an essay's cited records are in its references container.
